text.text: Your med spa in one place. Start with Appointments for today's treatments, keep Memberships healthy with credits and renewal dates, and check Inventory for items to reorder. Operational tracking only; clinical charting stays in your clinical system.
The consultation is where trust is built and where the legal groundwork for treatment is laid. Rushing it costs more than it saves.
with phone, email and how they heard about you

text.text: Treatment products expire, injectables need lot tracking, and retail skincare ties up cash. A weekly count keeps all three under control.
Every injectable, peel solution, numbing cream and treatment consumable, with
Retail products by size and shade.
Lot number and best-before date entered
Cold-chain products straight into the fridge; temperature log signed
Older stock moved to the front
says Reorder when on hand is at or below the reorder point. Order those.
Look at anything with a best-before date in the next 30 days. Use it first, or move it into a promotion if it is retail.
Expired treatment products are removed and logged, never used.
Every injectable visit records the product lot on the appointment. If a manufacturer issues a recall, filter Appointments by that lot and you have the list of clients to contact the same day.
Face the shelf daily and keep testers clean and dated.
Recommend retail only when it supports the treatment plan; a client using the right cleanser and sunscreen gets better results and trusts the advice.
Note retail sold on the appointment so the provider sees what the client is using at home.

The numbing cream on the shelf passed its best-before date five days ago. It is pulled, logged and replaced from the next order; the hydrating mask count is under the reorder point, so it goes on the same order.
Most aesthetic results need a series or regular upkeep. A client who leaves without the next visit is a client you may not see again.
Book the next session at the right spacing before payment: neurotoxin every three to four months, facials monthly, laser every four to eight weeks, microneedling every four weeks in a series.
Offer two times, not an open question.
If they will not book, ask permission to text a reminder at the right time, and note it on the client's page.
